name: HIKING_TRAIL_YELLOWGREEN_LONG
notes: DIT SA Standard Road Sign Index sheet (A4, legends and dimensions outlined, colour legend; size from the sheet's size table = register). Every dimension from the sheet; AS 1744 (plus0) spacing. The sheet's two edge figures are the edge strip (ground colour) and edge + black border, as the AS 1743 drawings. Sheet W8-SA104: W8-SA104B 750 x 500 illustrated (A 600 x 400, C 900 x 600; PNG W8-SA104A.png), fluorescent yellow-green, R50, 10 / 30. Chain 94 / 125 / 62 / 125 / 94: HIKING 125 D top 94, 521 (114/521/115); TRAIL 125 D top 281, 444 (153/444/153). With W6-1 only, on rural roads at hiking-trail crossing points.
